assessment:
Coverage is broad. The eleven areas together read almost every file my sweep returned for web and Mac Artifacts/Design (`grep -rli "artifact|juno:artifact|DesignDocument|design editor|canvas" src native`, 412 hits). The comparison with the files_read lists still shows four gaps. Each one has a concrete defect or an unanswered question behind it.

READ, not covered by any area:
1. Editing a message deletes artifacts. PATCH src/app/api/messages/[id]/route.ts:30-44 deletes every Artifact whose pinned message is newer than the edited user message, in the same transaction. The pin is set only at creation (src/lib/artifacts-store.ts:68). Artifact shares cascade (prisma/schema.prisma:1822). The edit UI asks for no confirmation (src/components/chat/message-item.tsx:1024-1028), and ↑ in an empty composer triggers it. On the client, mergeArtifacts never removes entries (src/hooks/use-chat.ts:344-352). Auditors covered regenerate and conversation delete, not message edit.
2. Every artifact version is loaded in full. getConversationThread uses `include: { versions: true }` (src/lib/queries.ts:117-121). The attachment query right above it was deliberately trimmed for the same 12s recovery poll (104-110). A design checkpoint is created per 30s of editing and on every AI transaction (src/lib/design/operations.ts:529-539).
3. The chat Canvas carries the whole design editor. canvas-panel statically imports DesignEditor (src/components/canvas/canvas-panel.tsx:44), so opening any artifact pulls it in. The Mac bundle's editor.js is 950,653 bytes.
4. There is no telemetry for artifacts or designs. Only console.* calls exist, for example src/app/api/design/[artifactId]/edit/route.ts:206 and src/lib/artifacts-store.ts:22. src/lib/observability.ts has no artifact metric.
5. Public links have no governance:
   - findActiveShare checks only revokedAt (src/lib/share.ts:131-139).
   - banUser does not touch shares (src/lib/moderation.ts:152).
   - Admin moderation has no view of shares or artifacts.
   - The share page has no report-abuse control.
   - POST /api/share, POST /api/artifacts/[id], design transactions, design create and design export have no rate limit. Only design edit (:102) and artifact export (:74) do.
   - No plan sets an artifact, version or storage quota.
   - src/components/share/shared-links-card.tsx was never read.
   - ProjectMember OWNER/EDITOR/VIEWER roles (schema.prisma:595-607) are an existing permission model that no auditor weighed for collaboration.
6. Nothing measures the model's output. scripts/eval-juno.ts has no artifact or design category. Canvas is on for every model and plan (src/app/api/chat/route.ts:2110). FREE caps output at 8192 tokens (src/lib/plans.ts:53), while an artifact may be 200,000 characters and every revision must re-emit it whole (system-prompt.ts:257).

INFERRED or minor, left out of the follow-ups to stay within four:
- Opening the Canvas moves focus nowhere; canvas-panel has no .focus() call. Below 50rem the chat column holding the focused Open button is hidden (src/components/chat/chat-view.tsx:1996-2000), so focus is likely lost.
- The web shortcut sheet has no Canvas or Design group (src/components/app/command-palette.tsx:1328-1373).
- The Mac app has no .xcstrings catalogue, and the bundled editor never gets the web's DOM auto-translate.
- The liquid-glass branch adds native/macOS/JunoDesktop/App/InlineArtifactCard.swift, a static tile unlike the web's live card. No auditor diffed it, because they diffed only files that already exist on main.
- docs/design/artifacts-design/research/claude-primary-evidence.md (untracked, 112 lines) holds the Claude comparison evidence that the motion auditor said was unverified, and no auditor used it.

I ran the unread design and artifact tests (artifact-edit, design-authoring, design-ai, design-schema, design-layout): 68 passed, 0 failed. The worktree is clean apart from the untracked docs/design/artifacts-design/.
